title: Don't Get Too Attached to Any AI App
summary: OpenAI discontinued its resource-intensive video generation model, Sora, due to financial constraints and the need to prioritize a new enterprise-focused AI model. This decision, influenced by the limited computing resources and the necessity to monetize its services, reflects a common challenge faced by AI companies.
sentiment_reason: The decision to abandon Sora, despite its user base and revenue, indicates financial struggles and the difficulty in monetizing AI services, leading to negative market sentiment.
